style: Original playful reactor-greenhouse game art with chunky hand-inked dark teal contours, flat gouache-like color masses and restrained dry-brush texture. Botanical shapes mixed with improvised copper machinery and cream ceramics; mint, lime, peach, coral and cyan accents over deep teal. Square event illustration like a storybook vignette, one clear focal subject, soft dark vignette at the edges. No people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no UI.

assets.prompt: A cracked copper reactor sprinkler head on a pipe hissing warm glowing lime mist into a dim greenhouse corner, puddle of glowing runoff water below with tiny sprouts.
A single huge beautiful flower glowing with eerie radioactive lime light, its petals edged in plum sludge, growing out of a leaking waste barrel, gold coins scattered among its roots.
A quirky old seed vault vending machine robot with a glass front full of seed capsules, potion bottles and one glowing relic, a coin slot mouth and a cheerful screen face, overgrown with vines.
A tall steaming compost heap with glints of gold coins and a mysterious glowing object buried deep inside, a rusty garden shovel stuck in the top.
A patched-up training scarecrow robot made of a flowerpot head, broom arms and a target painted on its chest, striking a silly challenging boxing pose on a greenhouse training mat.
A cozy greenhouse hot spring pool of warm mint-green water in a big ceramic basin, floating lily pads, a watering can and a little tool bench for polishing gear, gentle steam.
A dapper pruning robot barber with scissor hands and a tiny mustache, standing next to a barber chair made from a flowerpot, trimmed leaves on the floor, a price sign without text.
A glass mutation pod filled with bubbling cyan liquid and a swirling seed inside, cables and copper valves around it, strange mutated plants growing nearby.
A giant sprout growing out of an old copper prize wheel with six colored segments showing symbols of a coin, a relic gem, a heart, a skull and a waste barrel, playful carnival feeling.
An ancient twisted root system wrapped around a glowing rare relic crystal, surgical copper grafting tools laid out on a ceramic tray beside it, roots reaching out invitingly.
